{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u010/system/state/workspace/programs/task-77520c89.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Copy the colored pattern into the zero rectangle, mirrored horizontally."""
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # The zero rectangle marks the destination.
    zeros = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == 0]
    if not zeros:
        return g
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in zeros), max(r for r, _ in zeros)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in zeros), max(c for _, c in zeros)
    # The source is the non-background pattern above/away from the destination.
    background = max(set(v for row in g for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if g[r][c] != background and g[r][c] != 0]
    sr0, sr1 = min(r for r, _ in cells), max(r for r, _ in cells)
    sc0, sc1 = min(c for _, c in cells), max(c for _, c in cells)
    source = [g[r][sc0:sc1 + 1] for r in range(sr0, sr1 + 1)]
    for dr in range(r1 - r0 + 1):
        for dc in range(c1 - c0 + 1):
            g[r0 + dr][c0 + dc] = source[dr][-(dc + 1)]
    return g
